angle: Why Frieren's combat writing rewards rewatching more than any current shounen
description:
Frieren combat is the most rewatchable fight writing on TV right now, and this video breaks down exactly why.

We go scene by scene through the Aura fight and the mana-measuring tells most viewers miss on the first watch.

Chapters below. Playlist and the follow-up video are linked.
